title: Website Speed Impact on Conversions
takeaway: A one-second delay in page load time can lead to a 7% decrease in conversions.

narration: Research indicates that a single second delay in website loading time can significantly impact conversion rates. Optimizing for speed directly translates to increased customer engagement and improved business outcomes.
